notes_for_editor: Only two records: the tnlandforms tower list (NCT211, which also gives an unexplained code, gw/thd, not an NGS PID) and a MountainZone summit page that says nothing about a tower. Connelly Mountain is not among the 31 North Carolina entries on the National Historic Lookout Register list (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/NC) or on the Forest Lookouts North Carolina list, so no register or agency source was found. The story is about 65 words, below the usual 120-word floor, because nothing more can be cited without padding. Worth another look only if an NC Forest Service, FFLA or NC biennial-report record turns up. Two search calls were used; neither found a tower record.
